universe: US-listed equities from tracked US-politician disclosures (Capitol Trades feed via MCP)
entry_rule: politician BUY disclosure with disclosure_age <= max_disclosure_age_days (45, ADVISORY/assumed) AND technical confirmation (price > SMA50 or RSI not overbought); conviction-bucket sizing
exit_rule: stop-loss; time-based holding period; mirror a disclosed politician SELL
signal_bar: t (disclosure observed by close of day t)
sizing: conviction-bucket trade size; min_trade_value_usd floor; limit_offset_pct from mid price
benchmark: buy & hold SPY with identical friction
notes: max_disclosure_age_days and the holding period are ASSUMED, not yet measured against the actual disclosure-lag decay curve. Backtesting the formalized rule to find the profit-maximizing (lag, holding, max-age) is COMMITTEE-GATED and must pass PBO + deflated-Sharpe with a hard N-floor; on thin/survivorship-biased history it is expected to refuse to assert.
